description: This PHP source file is part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically within the admin controller extension for managing modules. It defines a 'Module' class that provides functionalities to list, install, and uninstall module extensions within the admin interface.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Controller class for managing module extensions in the OpenCart admin panel, providing methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of modules by setting the output of the response to the getList method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data about available and installed modules, including generating links for actions like edit, delete, install, and uninstall, then renders the module list view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a module extension, including permission checks, copying controller/model files, and registering autoloaders.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a module extension, including permission checks and cleanup of associated modules.
